title: Based Accounts
tagline: Intent based account abstraction. The project implements generic intent plugins for user controlled accounts
description: It offers a robust, extensible account system tailored for the EVM, leveraging beacon proxies and handlers to validate and execute arbitrary intents. Our design facilitates an off-chain auction service to ensure best execution for these intents, providing a versatile tool for developers aiming to create sophisticated decentralised applications.
how_its_made: This project uses an off chain auction api for publishing intents and ranking solver solutions. The contracts validate the solution and signatures within the intents. Two generic intent plugins have been built, one for simply transferring tokens and one for swapping on uniswap V3 with best swap path selection and ranking.
